text: dsh-reveal-in-explorer 是面向 DSH Web 的界面插件，在聊天里的文件引用旁提供悬停浮层入口。插件识别助手回复中的文件名、Markdown 文件链接、文件 chip、交付文件卡片及带路径提示的聊天控件；悬停后可通过按钮请求宿主在系统文件管理器中显示该路径。相对路径会结合当前会话工作目录补全，弹层会按视口空间调整位置。点击原有文件引用的预览行为保持原样，界面支持中英文和键盘操作。需要 DSH 提供 remote.session 与 shell.overlay。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer adds a hover action to file references in DSH Web chat. It recognizes file mentions, links, chips, and delivered-file cards, then asks the host to reveal paths in the system file manager. Relative paths use the session workspace. The existing preview click stays unchanged.
想在 DSH 聊天里直接用文件管理器定位某个文件。
悬停聊天中的文件路径时，能不能出现打开所在位置的按钮？
How can I reveal a file mentioned in chat in my desktop file manager?
dsh-reveal-in-explorer 的功能「悬停定位文件」：在聊天文件引用上悬停或聚焦后显示浮层按钮，点击后通过 DSH 宿主请求在系统文件管理器中显示文件；相对路径按当前会话工作目录补全。
dsh-reveal-in-explorer 的功能「识别多种文件引用」：识别回复内文件名、Markdown 文件链接、输入或消息中的文件 chip、交付文件卡片，以及提示内容看起来像路径的聊天控件。

> 在 DeepSeek Harness 聊天里悬停蓝色文件引用，一键用系统文件管理器定位该文件。

[English](README.en.md) · 中文

默认点击文件引用仍然走 Harness 原生行为（在右侧栏预览），本插件只在**悬停**时多给一个入口：直接打开资源管理器 / Finder / Linux 文件管理器并选中该文件。
dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · dsh-reveal-in-explorer：**已在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（Windows / DeepSeek Harness Desktop）上实测**：悬停出浮层、点击跳转资源管理器均正常。其他版本请以 `engines.dsh` 范围为准，见[兼容性](#兼容性)。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 功能：- **悬停即出**：指针在文件引用上停留 160ms，浮层在引用**右侧**弹出「📂 在资源管理器中显示」；右侧空间不足时依次退到下方、上方，并始终夹在视口内。
- **默认行为不变**：点击引用依旧在右侧栏预览，不劫持任何原生交互。
- **平台自适应**：由宿主 `open-in-app` / `native-command` 决定落点——Windows `explorer.exe /select,`，macOS `open -R`，Linux 打开所在目录。
- **相对路径补全**：`docs/a.md` 这类工作区相对路径会用当前会话的 `cwd` 补成绝对路径。
- **安全边界**：路径由宿主 `remote.session.openWorkspacePath({ action: 'reveal' })` 校验，插件本身不 spawn 进程、不读文件内容。
- **失败可见**：宿主拒绝（路径不存在、无权限、没有桌面文件管理器）时，浮层**保持打开**并把宿主给的原因显示在按钮第二行，同时 `console.warn` 一条带路径与原因的日志，方便开 Issue 时直接贴。
- **中英双语**、跟随宿主主题 token、键盘可达（`focusin` 同样触发，`Esc` 关闭）。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 覆盖的引用类型：| 位置 | DOM 形态 |
| --- | --- |
| 助手回复中的内联代码文件引用（蓝色文件名） | `code > button[title]` |
| Markdown 链接形式的文件路径 | `button.fileLink[title]` |
| 输入框 / 用户消息中的文件 chip | `[data-ref-chip="file"][title]` |
| 交付文件卡片 | `[data-presented-file] button[title]` |
| 其它带路径 tooltip 的聊天内控件 | `[data-chat-flow] button[title]` / `a[title]` |

最后一条是兜底：tooltip 看起来像路径（含分隔符，或形如 `name.ext`）才认，`Copy`、`Open in sidebar` 这类动作文案会被排除。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-reveal-in-explorer
```

尚未发布到 NPM 时，直接从本仓库源码安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Ghdhdhhake/dsh-reveal-in-explorer
```

或从本地目录安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-reveal-in-explorer
```

把 `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名即可（如 `desktop`）。安装后刷新页面即可；Client 改动热加载，无需重启。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 手动挂载（离线环境）：本机网络策略可能拦下 pnpm 访问 registry。此时把目录以 `link:` 依赖装进 profile，再让 profile 的 bundle 栈挂载它：

1. profile 的 `package.json`：

```json
   "dependencies": { "dsh-reveal-in-explorer": "link:/path/to/dsh-reveal-in-explorer" }
   ```

2. `pnpm-lock.yaml` 的 `importers['.']` 下补：

```yaml
   dsh-reveal-in-explorer:
     specifier: link:/path/to/dsh-reveal-in-explorer
     version: link:/path/to/dsh-reveal-in-explorer
   ```

3. `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `dsh-reveal-in-explorer`，然后：

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 手动挂载（离线环境）：```sh
   pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts --config.trust-lockfile=true
   ```
dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 卸载：在 **设置 → 插件** 中停用并移除 `dsh-reveal-in-explorer`，或从 profile 的 `dependencies` / `dsh.profile.bundles` 删除后重新安装依赖。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 开发：```sh
node scripts/build.mjs      # 由 src/ 生成 lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js
node scripts/check.mjs      # 清单、资源、选择器契约与发布文件一致性
npm test                    # 单元测试（Node 内置 test runner，无依赖）
```

或一次跑完：`npm run verify`。全部零依赖、不联网，Windows PowerShell 里可直接运行。`lib/` 是提交进仓库的构建产物，安装时不会执行任何构建脚本。

`npm test` 显式列出四个测试文件（Node 20 不支持 `--test` 的 glob，cmd.exe 也不会展开 `*`），`scripts/check.mjs` 会校验「`test/` 下每个 `*.test.mjs` 都在脚本里」——新增测试文件忘了登记会直接失败，而不是静默不跑。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 测试覆盖：| 文件 | 覆盖内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `test/paths.test.mjs` | **路径拼接核心**：Windows 盘符/UNC、macOS/Linux 斜杠、绝对路径优先、空工作区、CJK 与空格文件名 |
| `test/selectors.test.mjs` | **选择器契约**：用 `test/fixtures/chat-transcript.html` 校验每个 `SELECTORS` 仍能命中，DSH 升级改名时 CI 立刻失败 |
| `test/behaviour.test.mjs` | 注册契约、`inject`、Host 请求参数、失败原因透传、`console.warn` 日志、浮层定位 |
| `test/render.test.mjs` | 浮层各状态渲染：空闲/忙碌/成功/失败（含错误原因第二行）、主题 token、视口内夹取 |

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 测试覆盖：`test/fixtures/chat-transcript.html` 是从 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 客户端产物里核对过的**结构快照**（内联代码引用、Markdown 文件链接、`@` chip、交付文件卡片、以及 `Copy`/`Retry` 这类不该响应的干扰项）。宿主改结构时先改这个 fixture，测试会指出是哪条选择器失效。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 目录：```
src/index.js           Host 入口（空实现，仅给 bundle 一个 Host 行）
src/client/index.js    Client 实现（CJS factory 源码，含 SELECTORS 契约表）
lib/index.js           构建产物：Host 入口
lib/client.js          构建产物：带 __ModuleLoader__ 外壳的 client bundle

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 兼容性：- `engines.dsh`: **`>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0`**（写在 `package.json`，DSH 安装前会据此校验；不满足时安装被拦下而不是装上再崩）。
- **实测版本**：`0.2.1-rc.2`（Windows / DeepSeek Harness Desktop）。CI 在 Ubuntu 与 Windows 的 Node 20/22/24 上跑构建、清单检查与全部单测。
- 依赖宿主已装配的 `remote.session`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes`）与 `shell.overlay` 槽位。缺失时插件降级为无操作，不会让页面报错。
- 宿主没有桌面文件管理器（例如纯服务器部署）时，浮层会出现但点击会在第二行显示失败原因，不会假装成功。

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · 已知限制：- 文件引用的识别依赖宿主当前渲染出的 DOM 形态；选择器集中在 `SELECTORS` 一处，宿主改结构时只需改那里并同步 `test/fixtures/chat-transcript.html`。
- 浮层按引用元素的包围盒定位；引用被裁剪或滚出视口时浮层会关闭而不是跟随。
- Linux 上没有通用的“选中文件”协议，宿主会打开所在目录（这是 DSH `native-command` 的既定行为）。

> Hover a blue file reference in the DeepSeek Harness chat to reveal that file in your operating system's file manager.

English · [中文](README.md)

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · dsh-reveal-in-explorer：Clicking a file reference keeps the native behaviour (open it in the right Sidebar). This plugin only adds a **hover** affordance: one click opens Explorer / Finder / the Linux file manager with the file selected.

**Tested on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`** (Windows, DeepSeek Harness Desktop): hover, chip, and the Explorer hand-off all work. For other versions see the `engines.dsh` range under [Compatibility](#compatibility).

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Features：- **Hover to reveal** — after a 160 ms dwell the overlay shows “📂 Reveal in File Explorer” to the **right** of the reference, falling back to below, then above, and always clamped inside the viewport.
- **Native click untouched** — the plugin never intercepts the existing preview action.
- **Platform-aware** — the Host's `open-in-app` / `native-command` decides the target: `explorer.exe /select,` on Windows, `open -R` on macOS, the parent directory on Linux.
- **Workspace-relative paths** — `docs/a.md` is resolved against the active Session's `cwd`.
- **Host-verified** — paths go through `remote.session.openWorkspacePath({ action: 'reveal' })`; the plugin spawns no process and reads no file content.
- **Failures stay visible** — when the Host refuses (missing path, no permission, no desktop file manager) the chip **stays open** and shows the Host's reason on a second line, and one `console.warn` line records the path plus the reason for issue reports.
- **Bilingual UI**, theme-token styling, keyboard reachable (`focusin` also arms it, `Esc` closes).

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Covered reference types：| Surface | DOM shape |
| --- | --- |
| Inline-code file reference in an assistant reply (the blue filename) | `code > button[title]` |
| Markdown link that points at a path | `button.fileLink[title]` |
| Composer / user-message file chip | `[data-ref-chip="file"][title]` |
| Delivered-file card | `[data-presented-file] button[title]` |
| Fallback for other chat controls with a path tooltip | `[data-chat-flow] button[title]` / `a[title]` |

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Covered reference types：The fallback only accepts tooltips that look like paths (a separator, or a bare `name.ext`), so action labels such as `Copy` or `Open in sidebar` are ignored.

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-reveal-in-explorer
```

Before the package is published to NPM, install straight from this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Ghdhdhhake/dsh-reveal-in-explorer
```

Or from a local directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-reveal-in-explorer
```

Swap `web` for your own profile name (for example `desktop`). Refresh the page afterwards; Client changes hot-reload, no restart needed.

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Manual mount (offline)：If pnpm cannot reach the registry, install the directory as a `link:` dependency and let the profile's bundle stack mount it:

1. In the profile's `package.json`:

```json
   "dependencies": { "dsh-reveal-in-explorer": "link:/path/to/dsh-reveal-in-explorer" }
   ```

2. In `pnpm-lock.yaml` under `importers['.']`:

```yaml
   dsh-reveal-in-explorer:
     specifier: link:/path/to/dsh-reveal-in-explorer
     version: link:/path/to/dsh-reveal-in-explorer
   ```

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Manual mount (offline)：3. Add `dsh-reveal-in-explorer` to `dsh.profile.bundles`, then:

```sh
   pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts --config.trust-lockfile=true
   ```

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Uninstall：Disable and remove `dsh-reveal-in-explorer` under **Settings → Plugins**, or delete it from the profile's `dependencies` / `dsh.profile.bundles` and reinstall dependencies.

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Development：```sh
node scripts/build.mjs   # src/ → lib/index.js and lib/client.js
node scripts/check.mjs   # manifest, resources, selector contract, shipped files
npm test                 # unit tests (Node's built-in runner, no dependencies)
```

Or run everything with `npm run verify`. All of it is dependency-free and offline. `lib/` is committed, so installing the bundle never runs a build script.

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Development：`npm test` lists the four test files explicitly (Node 20 does not expand globs for `--test`, and cmd.exe does not either). `scripts/check.mjs` verifies that every `*.test.mjs` under `test/` is listed, so a new test file that nobody registered fails the build instead of silently never running.

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Test coverage：| File | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `test/paths.test.mjs` | **Path joining**, the cross-platform core: Windows drive/UNC, macOS/Linux separators, absolute-wins, empty workspace, CJK and spaces |
| `test/selectors.test.mjs` | **Selector contract**: every `SELECTORS` entry still resolves against `test/fixtures/chat-transcript.html`, so a DSH markup change fails CI |
| `test/behaviour.test.mjs` | Registration contract, `inject`, the exact Host request, failure reasons, the `console.warn` line, chip placement |
| `test/render.test.mjs` | Popup states: idle/busy/done/error (including the reason line), theme tokens, viewport clamping |

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Test coverage：`test/fixtures/chat-transcript.html` is a **structural snapshot** checked against the DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 client bundles: inline-code mentions, Markdown file links, `@` chips, delivered-file cards, and decoys (`Copy`, `Retry`) that must stay inert. When the Host changes its markup, update the fixture first — the tests then name the selector that broke.

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Layout：```
src/index.js           Host entry (empty; gives the bundle a Host row)
src/client/index.js    Client implementation (CommonJS factory source + SELECTORS table)
lib/index.js           Built Host entry
lib/client.js          Built client bundle wrapped in the __ModuleLoader__ envelope

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Compatibility：- `engines.dsh`: **`>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0`**, declared in `package.json` so DSH rejects an incompatible install instead of loading it and crashing later.
- **Verified on** `0.2.1-rc.2` (Windows, DeepSeek Harness Desktop). CI builds and runs the full suite on Ubuntu and Windows across Node 20/22/24.
- Needs the Host's `remote.session` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes`) and the `shell.overlay` slot. When either is missing the plugin degrades to a no-op instead of breaking the page.
- On a host without a desktop file manager (a plain server, for example) the chip still appears, but clicking shows the failure reason on its second line rather than pretending success.

dsh-reveal-in-explorer README · Known limitations：- Reference detection follows the DOM the Host renders today; the selectors live in one `SELECTORS` table, so a markup change means editing that table and the fixture.
- The overlay is positioned from the reference's bounding box and closes when the reference scrolls out of view.
- Linux has no common "select this file" protocol, so the Host opens the containing directory instead (that is DSH `native-command` behaviour).
